scope: Design discussion and literature/backlog inventory only. No GPU work, training, model change or selected architecture extras.
starting_point: Plain DFlash; user-selected W1 and activations above one bit; modern DFlash Q4_K_M remains baseline.

classification.Q: Chosen learned/task-adapted variant belongs in QAT or auxiliary training. Not a claim that the generic mechanism mathematically requires end-to-end QAT.
classification.I: Fixed/analytic/calibration-search variant can be screened without task-loss parameter training. Learned recovery is separately assigned to Q; independence does not promise preserved acceptance.

priorities.include: Proposed reference capability or engineering principle, not approved implementation.

items.name: Trainable binary signs and learned row scales
items.mechanism: Learn the actual binary function instead of freezing a rounded checkpoint. Scale-only control remains useful.
items.qualification: Full-sign modern DFlash training remains unqualified; scale adaptation has prior local evidence.

items.name: Learned input-channel scales plus output-row scales
items.mechanism: Give binary projections channel-dependent amplitudes with two small vectors.
items.qualification: Additional input scaling changes activation codes; not safely folded through rounding.

items.name: Learned within-row group scales
items.mechanism: Give groups of connections independently trained strengths.
items.qualification: Extra scale loads and scaled partial sums; prior grouping+rotation experiments confounded.

items.name: Learned binary centers and projection bias
items.mechanism: Asymmetric binary values and/or a learned output offset.
items.qualification: Weight center times sum of inputs is not the same operation as a constant output bias.

items.name: Adapt existing normalization gains; optional extra normalization or residual gains
items.mechanism: Let scale and branch balance adapt to quantization. Additional normalization is a separate architecture trial.
items.qualification: Do not claim existing DFlash RMSNorm/residual connections as additions.

items.name: Learned activation clipping and step sizes
items.mechanism: Learn range and rounding-grid spacing; optionally learn asymmetric offsets.
items.qualification: PACT originated in vision; signed SiLU inputs need an appropriate signed quantizer, not copied nonnegative PACT.

items.name: Training-integrated transforms
items.mechanism: Use an online Hadamard or learned rotation/affine transform before selected low-bit projections and adapt the model to it.
items.qualification: Fixed Hadamard has no trainable parameters itself. Inserting it into a strict-W1 graph still needs compatible reparameterization or adaptation; BitNet v2 is ternary.

items.name: Task-trained low-rank correction
items.mechanism: Add a small high-precision residual projection and train it on draft predictions.
items.qualification: Local reconstruction and native-prefix improvements did not reliably improve full requests in old backlog.

items.name: Task-trained sparse outlier correction
items.mechanism: Spend higher precision on selected connections or channels that binary weights cannot represent well.
items.qualification: Index/gather/kernel costs and added payload must be counted.

items.name: Extra binary planes with learned amplitudes and residual-aware training
items.mechanism: Add selective binary residual contributions; discourage different planes from learning the same correction.
items.qualification: More than one bit per selected connection. RaBiT coupled paths require a new training implementation, not just extra independent weights.

items.name: Activation sparsification trained in the forward pass
items.mechanism: Teach the model to tolerate dropping small activations; combine with A4/A8 where appropriate.
items.qualification: Zeros in a dense tensor do not automatically save GPU time. Literature precedent largely ternary.

items.name: Target-distribution distillation
items.mechanism: Train against probabilities from the exact intended target; test CE/KL combinations and temperature.
items.qualification: Conditional shortlist mass must not be confused with full-vocabulary probabilities; no local modern KD win established.

items.name: Block/output or intermediate-feature reconstruction auxiliaries
items.mechanism: Use aligned higher-precision outputs as temporary training guidance.
items.qualification: Hidden representations need not remain identical after binary adaptation; do not replace target-probability supervision with hidden MSE.

items.name: Verification-aware and expected-progress losses
items.mechanism: Compare VAT, EAL/WTV or EDR against base DFlash loss, matching greedy versus sampling semantics.
items.qualification: Base DFlash already weights early positions. Recent simple depth weighting/smoothing did not establish local extra speed.

items.name: Serving-state replay, balanced coverage and prefix/margin retention
items.mechanism: Adapt on correct native histories and representative domains; replay successful prefixes while learning failures.
items.qualification: Data fidelity is required; replay weighting and margin protection are experiments, not demonstrated universal gains.

items.name: Quantizer-aware gradients, latent initialization and parameter-group learning rates
items.mechanism: Explicitly choose straight-through/scale-gradient rules and separate sign/scale/norm update policies.
items.qualification: Use a simple reproducible control; alternative estimators are trials, with vision versus LLM evidence distinguished.

items.name: Oscillation damping, selective freezing and stability schedules
items.mechanism: Reduce unproductive sign flipping only when diagnostics identify it.
items.qualification: CNN evidence does not establish a transformer gain; full EMA parameter averaging can change binary signs.

items.name: Precision/coverage curricula
items.mechanism: Compare direct final-precision training with staged W1 coverage or A8-to-A4 adaptation.
items.qualification: Charge all stages; curriculum is not automatically better than direct training.

items.name: Learned acceptance/confidence predictor
items.mechanism: Predict useful proposal length rather than relying only on logit gaps.
items.qualification: Can fit an auxiliary head separately; trained component, not a mandatory full-model QAT run.

items.name: Token-conditioned correction: Markov or contextual candidate scoring
items.mechanism: DSpark-style sequential adjustment or DCOCO-style parallel scoring of adjacent candidate pairs.
items.qualification: Not a validated gain for W1 or our modern baseline. DCOCO scoring is parallel; path selection still follows predecessors.

items.name: Learned head compression or candidate selection
items.mechanism: Train a factorized head, reduced-vocabulary head or shortlist predictor.
items.qualification: A frozen subset or SVD approximation can be tested without QAT; learned recovery belongs here.

items.name: Alternative fusion/tap selection and width/depth adaptation
items.mechanism: Train a revised target-feature interface or resized draft body if capacity is the bottleneck.
items.qualification: Normal feature fusion/KV injection already exist. Changed taps and shape need new captures and export contract.

items.name: Binary factorization, binary experts or learned binary codecs
items.mechanism: Alternative representation families such as LittleBit factors, mixture routing, BTC-LLM codebooks or BiSCo decoders.
items.qualification: Not plain one-plane W1 matrix multiplication; total factors/decoder/routing cost matters.

items.name: Alternative binary optimizers and reduced training state
items.mechanism: Bop or recent error-diffusion updates avoid ordinary full-precision latent/Adam state.
items.qualification: Training-resource research, not inference feature; recent ED evidence is on much smaller language models.

items.name: Selective W1 coverage and protected operations
items.mechanism: Keep an explicit precision map: FFN, attention, fusion, head/embedding, norm/residual, accumulator and KV precision separately.
items.qualification: No learned selector required. Restoring weights after adaptation is not guaranteed to preserve behavior.

items.name: Per-operation A8/A4 and scale granularity
items.mechanism: Start an A8 reference; independently screen per-token, group-wise and mixed precision quantizers.
items.qualification: Selecting a policy needs no QAT, but an adapted final model should train with its chosen policy.

items.name: Fixed or calibrated clipping, scaling and code grids
items.mechanism: Absmax/absmean/percentile or calibration-search scales, symmetric/asymmetric grids and explicit zero-point treatment.
items.qualification: No parameter gradient required for these variants. They can alter acceptance and need native testing.

items.name: Data-aware binary initialization and row-orientation rescue
items.mechanism: Fit signs/scales to representative inputs before QAT; correct negatively correlated zero-scale row orientation.
items.qualification: Use calibrated reconstruction rather than assuming smaller weight error means better proposal choices.

items.name: Fixed group scales, affine corrections and fixed extra planes
items.mechanism: Analytic/calibrated representation controls before learning their parameters.
items.qualification: Representation variants require native kernels. Independent of QAT does not mean a zero-work kernel switch.

items.name: Fixed rotations and channel equalization
items.mechanism: Explore fixed QuaRot/SmoothQuant-style preprocessing or search fixed transforms using calibration statistics.
items.qualification: Learned SpinQuant/FlatQuant variants belong in Q07, even when described as PTQ. Folding a general rotation/column gain into W1 does not preserve the binary format.

items.name: Post-training low-rank or sparse correction
items.mechanism: SVD/calibration-fit a residual, or keep selected outliers in higher precision, without task-QAT.
items.qualification: SVDQuant is image-diffusion W4A4 evidence, not binary DFlash validation; correction fusion is important.

items.name: Post-training factorization and capacity allocation
items.mechanism: Factorization and sensitivity allocation as an alternate initializer/control; exclude learned global recovery from this independent portion.
items.qualification: The full AF1 pipeline includes learned-scale global reconstruction, assigned to Q01/Q23, so full AF1 is not a training-free feature. Factorization changes the single-sign-matrix representation.

items.name: Shape-specific kernel dispatch
items.mechanism: Use measured integer Tensor Core path as reference, with DP4A or other kernels only where actual shapes justify them.
items.qualification: Current local native A8 default wins screened methods on old DSpark/Qwen3-F16; no blanket binary-math advantage.

items.name: Prepacking, shared quantization and fused kernels
items.mechanism: Avoid repeated immutable transposes/unpacking; reuse compatible gate/up inputs; fuse norm/quantization, gate operations, scales and residual epilogues when legal.
items.qualification: A graph/rounding change still needs numerical and acceptance checks; no new speed measured in this survey.

items.name: CUDA graphs, buffers and synchronization reduction
items.mechanism: Reduce launch/allocation overhead, keep temporary data resident and batch compatible projections.
items.qualification: Profile first; existing optimizations may already cover part of this.

items.name: Compact output extraction and head execution
items.mechanism: GPU argmax/top-k, avoid unused logit transfers, exploit supported batched/shared-head execution.
items.qualification: Full-vocabulary transfer elimination already exists on some prior paths; do not count it again as new.

items.name: Context K/V reuse and minimal target-feature catch-up
items.mechanism: Avoid computing context queries/FFN/head outputs that are truly unused; preserve all required cache and feature updates.
items.qualification: DFlash already injects/caches context; optimization concerns redundant work, not removing required semantics.

items.name: Training-system efficiency independent of recipe
items.mechanism: Cached frozen features, chunked K/V-only context, batched heads, efficient optimizer kernels and activation checkpointing.
items.qualification: Must preserve update/mask/data semantics; caching invalid after incompatible target/prefix/tap changes. No training-state compression equivalence assumed.

items.name: Static/adaptive proposal-length and confidence-gap policies
items.mechanism: Choose block/prefix length from measured cost and existing logits or acceptance history.
items.qualification: Discarding computed slots does not save their draft compute; cost target verification separately.

items.name: Static or heuristic dynamic vocabulary shortlists
items.mechanism: Score selected output rows using a deterministic proposal policy without training a selector.
items.qualification: Top-k after full-head scoring saves no head matmul. Missing token support can lower acceptance; target verifier remains full and correct.

items.name: Beam/tree proposals, retries and suffix reuse
items.mechanism: Use multiple candidates or reuse draft material under correctly conditioned verification.
items.qualification: No automatic quality benefit; branch masks/KV rollback and valid sampling probabilities required; unchanged greedy retries repeat themselves.

items.name: Drafter-side KV/cache quantization
items.mechanism: Compress draft context memory when its cost is material.
items.qualification: Keep target/verifier precision fixed. Cache arithmetic changes can reduce acceptance; published long-context gains are not our short-block gains.

items.name: Structural pruning/slicing or frozen head factorization
items.mechanism: Try coupled gate/up/down channel slicing or SVD head compression as no-QAT controls.
items.qualification: Recovery training is a separate QAT variant; sparse/pruned sizes must suit actual kernels.

items.name: Per-stage and per-position diagnostics
items.mechanism: Measure quantization zeros/outliers, sign flips, accepted-prefix survival, packing/draft/head/verification time and total request speed.
items.qualification: Instrumentation and selection support, not a model quality feature; local proxy improvements alone cannot promote a candidate.

backlog_F01_F32.name: Two extra binary planes at down2/down3

evidence_cautions: 98 segments and 32 feature IDs overlap; they are not 130 independent experiments.
Modern prior scale-only result is EAGLE-family, not evidence for trained modern W1 DFlash.
Recent depth/smoothing arms established no extra throughput gain; many older tests were short and raw assets partially missing.
Modern activation screen was a small frozen-A8-weight probe, not equal-QAT/native evidence.
Native kernel comparison was old Qwen3 F16/DSpark, not modern target matrix.
BitNet v2 and a4.8 use ternary weights; OneBit uses floating activations in its reported binary-weight architecture.
PrismML public announcement checked; linked whitepaper unavailable through web fetch, no proprietary training recipe inferred.
baseline_not_additions: DFlash feature fusion and per-layer context KV injection
Existing residual paths, attention, normalization, shared frozen head/embeddings
search_stop: Multiple passes across current LLM, older BNN, PTQ and speculative literature converge on the mechanism families listed. New codebook/factor/optimizer leads retained as deferred branches. No claim of exhaustive literature or proved gains on our candidate.
unadopted_branches: W1A1 thresholds/parallel retries/tree work remains future track, not current >1-bit recipe.
Ternary/two-bit controls change weight alphabet; retain as diagnostic alternatives, not label as strict W1.
Binary-code compression with neural decoder is not direct sign-matrix arithmetic.
